from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    marker = min((v for v in counts if v != background), key=lambda v: counts[v])
    points = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == marker]
    if not points:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in points)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in points)
    shape = [(r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in points]
    bh = max(r for r, c in shape) + 1
    bw = max(c for r, c in shape) + 1
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h-bh+1):
        for c in range(w-bw+1):
            cells = [(r+dr, c+dc) for dr, dc in shape]
            if all(grid[a][b] == 0 for a, b in cells):
                for a, b in cells:
                    out[a][b] = marker
    return out
PY
